- For IC5 (Staff) we need an approval from Marcus and a recorded justification (impact metric: projected PV improvements or latency regression headroom).

I am copying Marcus for the escalation path. Also cc-ing finance would normally happen here; I’ll leave that to Marcus if he thinks we need pre-approval before offer.
